blocks.content: The Internet is a global network of interconnected computer networks that communicate using standard communication protocols. It enables users to access information, communicate with others, and share resources across the world. Email is one of the most widely used services provided through the Internet.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Internet is a global network of interconnected computer networks using TCP/IP protocols.
World Wide Web (WWW) is a system of interlinked hypertext documents accessed via the Internet.
Web Browsers are client application software used to locate, retrieve, and display web content.
Search Engines maintain searchable databases of web pages using automated web crawlers.
Email messaging relies on SMTP for sending emails and POP3/IMAP for receiving them.
HTTPS encrypts communication between the web browser and website using SSL/TLS protocols.

blocks.content: The Internet is a worldwide system of computer networks that are connected using the Internet Protocol Suite (TCP/IP). It connects millions of private, public, academic, business, and government networks.

items: Access to vast information resources.
Fast communication through email and messaging.
Online services such as banking, shopping, and education.
File sharing and collaboration.
Entertainment such as music, videos, and games.

blocks.content: The World Wide Web (WWW) is a system of interlinked web pages that are accessed through the Internet. It was invented by Tim Berners-Lee in 1989. Web pages are written using HTML and accessed through web browsers.

blocks.content: Email is a method of exchanging digital messages between users over the Internet. It is one of the earliest and most widely used Internet services.

cells: Files sent along with the email message

items: BCC (Blind Carbon Copy) addresses remain hidden from all other email recipients, whereas CC addresses are visible to everyone.
HTTP operates by default on Port 80, while encrypted HTTPS operates on Port 443.
A Web Browser is an application software installed on a device, whereas a Search Engine is a website/service running on web servers.
SMTP is used strictly for sending emails, while POP3 or IMAP are used for downloading/retrieving emails from servers.
